name: mobile.de
beschreibung: Listings, prices, ratings and customer inquiries of the dealer's own mobile.de account.

rechte.beschreibung: May view listings, price ratings and statistics at mobile.de.
May change prices, create, renew, reserve and delete listings and propose direct offers; each change only after approval.
May read customer inquiries from mobile.de with contact data and report their state back.
May read ratings and propose replies and invitations; each only after approval.

funktionen.name: seller_info
funktionen.beschreibung: Shows the dealer account at mobile.de: name, customer number, how many images a listing may have.

funktionen.name: list_ads
funktionen.beschreibung: Shows the listings in short form; search keeps only listings with every word (make, model, internal number).

funktionen.name: get_ad
funktionen.beschreibung: Shows one listing with all its details.

funktionen.name: ad_statistics
funktionen.beschreibung: Impressions, parkings, e-mails, calls and WhatsApp contacts of one listing. Do not store or aggregate them: mobile.de allows them only for the listing's lifetime.

funktionen.name: price_rating
funktionen.beschreibung: mobile.de's price rating for one listing (good, reasonable, increased price).

funktionen.name: preview_price_rating
funktionen.beschreibung: Which price rating a listing would get before it is online; ad in mobile.de's format.

funktionen.name: list_ratings
funktionen.beschreibung: Shows the dealer's ratings with their numbers.

funktionen.name: rating_overview
funktionen.beschreibung: Shows the dealer's overall rating (from the Gold package).

funktionen.name: list_leads
funktionen.beschreibung: Shows customer inquiries from mobile.de with contact data, vehicle and everything since (replies, calls); since is an ISO time.

funktionen.name: reference_data
funktionen.beschreibung: Shows mobile.de's fixed values for a listing: kind makes or models (needs make) of a vehicle_class (default Car), categories or a table such as fuels, gearboxes, colors; search filters. The listing takes the name, never the description.

funktionen.name: change_price
funktionen.beschreibung: Sets a listing's gross consumer price; the net price follows the VAT rate.

funktionen.name: set_reserved
funktionen.beschreibung: Marks a listing as reserved or removes the mark.

funktionen.name: renew_ad
funktionen.beschreibung: Renews a listing so it shows as new in the search; mobile.de may charge for it.

funktionen.name: delete_ad
funktionen.beschreibung: Deletes a listing with all its images. Cannot be undone.

funktionen.name: create_ad
funktionen.beschreibung: Creates a new listing. ad in mobile.de's format, at least vehicleClass, make and price.consumerPriceGross; images: each {"image": "img-…"} (a handed-over photo, see the briefing), {"url": "https://…"} or {"base64": "…"} (JPG up to 2 MB), in the order wanted.

funktionen.name: set_images
funktionen.beschreibung: Replaces all images of a listing; each {"image": "img-…"} (a handed-over photo), {"url": "https://…"} or {"base64": "…"} (JPG up to 2 MB).

funktionen.name: send_direct_offer
funktionen.beschreibung: Sends a direct offer to everyone who parked the listing: 3 to 1000 characters, no phone number or e-mail address, valid 1 to 14 days.

funktionen.name: invite_rating
funktionen.beschreibung: Invites the buyer of this vehicle to rate the dealer; only with their consent.

funktionen.name: reply_rating
funktionen.beschreibung: Publishes the dealer's reply to a rating (once per rating, up to 1000 characters).

funktionen.name: set_lead_status
funktionen.beschreibung: Reports the state of an inquiry to mobile.de: IN_PROGRESS, SOLD, NOT_INTERESTED or SPAM.

ereignisse.beschreibung: A prospect answered an inquiry at mobile.de.
A prospect asked about a vehicle again.
A call through mobile.de was not answered.
